description: One piece of work an agent did (or is still doing), as a lane surface draws it: the agent it belongs to, when it started, when it ended, what happened and — optionally — the review verdict it carries. The record is a VALUE: a host recomposes it with `block with { … }` when a block finishes or its state changes, and no component mutates it. End is null while the block is still open — a running block has no recorded end, so a surface draws it up to its own "now" instead of inventing a duration. An End EARLIER than Start is clamped to Start by EndAt (and by every layout and formatter), because a negative duration is never meaningful. Nothing here carries colour: the lane palette slot belongs to the agent (AgentRef.ColorIndex), so two blocks of one agent can never disagree about their identity. A blank Id is generated at construction, exactly like AgentRef's, so a list built in a loop still renders; a host that wants a stable selection supplies its own id.

members.name: Id
members.description: Stable identity of the block — the value a selection reports and the key an incremental event addresses. Never empty: a missing id is generated at construction.

members.name: AgentId
members.description: The id of the agent the block belongs to; AgentRef.Id names it on the snapshot.

members.name: Start
members.description: When the work started, on the host's clock.

members.name: End
members.description: When the work ended, or null while it is still open. A surface draws an open block up to its own "now" and marks it as running, so a live lane never shows a block that stops before the current moment.

members.name: Status
members.description: The block's own state. Default Idle; an unknown value renders no state word on the surface (the localized "Unknown state" instead), so a stale contract cannot paint a wrong verdict.

members.name: Label
members.description: What the work was, as the host wants it read. Empty renders no visible text — the surface falls back to the kind's word, and the accessible name still names the kind.

members.name: Kind
members.description: What kind of work the block represents. Default Task; painted as a decorative glyph plus a localized word.

members.name: Marker
members.description: The review verdict the block carries, or null when it carries none. null is not the same as a neutral marker, so a component draws nothing rather than a placeholder.

members.name: IsOpen
members.description: Whether the block is still open, i.e. End is null.

members.name: EndAt
members.description: The end a surface paints for the block: End when it is recorded, otherwise the supplied "now". An end before Start is clamped to Start, so a caller can never derive a negative duration from a block.
